column1: # Game profile of Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night (Switch, update 1.60 over the base game). This folder also holds the shader tables (generated by shader_split.py), pso_manifest.tsv and, not committed, c1_full.tsv and cb_extent.tsv
# Brought up from the provisional profile the NSP script wrote (dm/games/profile_guess.py); the base game v0 needs other keys and is not covered here (README.md, Versions)

# Unreal Engine 4.22: FMallocBinned3 would take 37 GB of address space; its constructor is cut and the host runs the allocator on a host malloc zone (dm/tools/ue_malloc.py finds it, dm/host/hle_uemalloc.c).
# What the game then maps itself fits Engage's 5 GB block, as DRAGON QUEST XI S's: 256 MB in front + 4.375 GB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 128 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 70 MB of system resource
# the decoded shader code archives: the engine's global shaders and the game's material shaders

column1: # The game asks for present interval 2 (30 fps); Unreal steps by elapsed time, so one frame per display tick plays at normal speed at 60 fps (1.0 on the iPhone, 2026-10-29)

# address regions: 2026-10-29, in its first 15 s in nnMain the game's regions reach alias +2.82 GB, within the profile's 4.38 GB alias region (what it takes later in play is not measured here) (rewrite 4696f684aecc)
# Unreal Engine 4.22 streams texture mips by writing them straight into the texture's storage from the CPU, after the texture was first used, with no NVN copy and no flush
# (the characters' 256x256 ASTC 6x6 ramp and matcap textures). Without these the host kept the first, partly written content: all-zero top levels, which ASTC decodes as magenta
